final: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), benchmark1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as b1 FROM order_avgs), above_b1 AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_remain, oa.avg_remain - b1.b1 as excess_b1 FROM order_avgs oa CROSS JOIN benchmark1 b1 WHERE oa.avg_remain > b1.b1), benchmark2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as b2 FROM above_b1), above_b2 AS (SELECT ab1.ordersmark, ab1.avg_remain, ab1.excess_b1, ab1.avg_remain - b2.b2 as excess_b2 FROM above_b1 ab1 CROSS JOIN benchmark2 b2 WHERE ab1.avg_remain > b2.b2) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as final_avg, AVG(excess_b1) as avg_excess_b1, AVG(excess_b2) as avg_excess_b2 FROM above_b2
